notes: Endorsement email status (owner 2026-11-19: "Is there anyway for tenants to see if an email has been delivered and opened? For this to show up near the payee signature request", then "Yeah build 1 and 2": 1 the payee opening the endorsement link, 2 delivered or bounced from Resend). check-endorsement.mjs: send_endorsement_request keeps the Resend email id of the payee's request (public.aws_endorsement_email_sent, SQL 170; only a real Resend send, never sink or SES; contractor copy notices are not tracked; emailStatusTracking in the response and email_status_tracking in the request_sent audit event); the payee's page load of a valid, unexpired link records an open on its own short write connection (public.aws_endorsement_link_opened); signing, declining and staff views record nothing; and a request carrying Svix headers is Resend's signed delivery report (handleEndorsementEmailWebhook: HMAC-SHA256 over svix-id.svix-timestamp.body with the whsec_ secret, five-minute tolerance, nothing read before the signature checks out; email.delivered, email.bounced with its reason and email.complained go to public.aws_endorsement_email_event; other types are acknowledged; a database failure answers 500 so Resend retries; no signing secret answers 503). The webhook URL is /functions/v1/check-endorsement, so app-services.mjs, email-queue.mjs and index.mjs are unchanged. Every status call is best effort, under a savepoint inside the request's transaction: a missing SQL 170 function or any other error never fails or changes a request, a page load or a signature. The signing secret is RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET in the provider secrets JSON or the environment (provider-secrets.mjs, live, returns every key of that JSON). No hold; sql_before stays null because the code works without SQL 170, but the status is only recorded once SQL 170 is applied. live_sha256 is the bytes production run 44386297099 applied 2026-11-18 (VERIFIED, re-inspect 44386464914), recorded in the endorsement copy notice applied manifest; a read-only production overlay inspect must confirm them before any apply. Not verified by this plan: a real Resend report reaching the function, and a real payee open.
